query:
SELECT w.number AS "number!: i64"
           FROM workspaces w
           JOIN proposals p ON p.id = w.proposal_id
           JOIN proposal_versions v ON v.id = w.version_id
           WHERE p.number = ?1 AND v.version = ?2 AND w.worker_id = ?3
             AND w.kind = 'review' AND w.state = 'active'
